databases.name: catalogo
databases.schema: CREATE TABLE clienti (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, nome TEXT); CREATE TABLE ordini (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cliente_id INTEGER, totale REAL, FOREIGN KEY(cliente_id) REFERENCES clienti(id));
